reports.title: Ultragenyx Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Announces Substantial Expense Reductions, and Reaffirms Profitability in 2027

lines: The company reaffirms its full year 2026 total revenue guidance of $730 million to $760 million, which excludes revenue from new product launches.
The company reaffirms its full year 2026 Crysvita revenue guidance of $500 million to $520 million.
The company reaffirms its full year 2026 Dojolvi revenue guidance of $100 million to $110 million.

To support this transition, the company has initiated substantial headcount and expense reductions and expects to reduce 2027 R&D expenses to less than $350 million and 2027 SG&A expenses to less than $375 million.

Fourth quarter 2026 financial results are expected to include approximately $25 million of severance and other non-recurring restructuring charges, and the reduction in force is expected to be substantially completed by the end of 2026.
